brief:
A child said goodbye to his father after an Israeli airstrike destroyed his family's apartment in Gaza City early today, killing his father, mother, and two sisters, Eye on Palestine reported. The strike targeted a residential building in the densely populated area.

The child was among survivors of the attack. Details on the number of total casualties and the circumstances prompting the strike were not immediately available.
dek: A child bids his father a final farewell after losing him, his mother, and his two sisters in an Israeli airstrike that targeted their apartment in Gaza City early this morning.
title: Child loses family in Gaza City airstrike
